figurative_meaning_en: To become restless due to anxiety; to fidget anxiously
similar_in_english: To be on pins and needles
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার ফলাফলের অপেক্ষায় সে হালুচালু করছিল।
খবর না পেয়ে তার মন হালুচালু হয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was fidgeting anxiously while waiting for the exam results.
Her mind became restless without hearing the news.
note: This idiom captures the vivid, onomatopoeic expression of unease common in Bengali oral tradition.
